summary: Adversarial audit of the reviewer demo account + Apple sign-in + .gitignore negation. All 19 new tests pass. Full backend suite: 878 passed, 9 skipped, 2 parallel-flaky (both pass when re-run in isolation — same class of flakiness the main agent already documented). No new failures introduced.
action_items: No action required from main agent — both the reviewer account and Apple sign-in behave exactly as the design intended under adversarial probing.
critical_code_review_comments: The reviewer path is well-scoped: auth_otp_verify has no reference to REVIEW_OTP / is_review_login / review_login (verified by both test_apple_signin_and_reviewer_account.test_verify_has_no_special_case_for_the_reviewer and manual grep). The whole safety argument holds — the fixed code goes through the ordinary expiry/attempt-cap/single-use path.
APPLE_AUDIENCES is derived from env with the legacy APPLE_SERVICES_ID kept as a fallback — good backward-compat.

backend/.gitignore and frontend/.gitignore both contain `!.env`; verified via `git status --porcelain --ignored` that appending `*.env` to root .gitignore does NOT re-ignore them (subdirectory pattern wins). Root .gitignore was restored after the test.
Minor: FastAPI @app.on_event('startup') is deprecated (server.py:100,169,231) — should move to lifespan handler. Not urgent.

success_rate.backend: 99.8% (878/880 non-flaky, 2 parallel-flakies both pass in isolation)

seed_data_creation: None. Tests clear per-identifier otp_requests rows before their bursts to avoid rate-limit leakage from earlier tests; the running test_credentials.md admin/reviewer accounts are used as-is.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 27 focused on: (1) the store-reviewer demo account cannot be turned into a general OTP bypass — a foreign identifier cannot use REVIEW_OTP, the reviewer code is single-use, the 5-attempt cap and 5-min expiry apply unchanged, the /request response leaks nothing; (2) Apple sign-in endpoint /api/auth/apple correctly rejects junk / wrong-key / wrong-audience tokens with 401; (3) APPLE_AUDIENCES contains BOTH com.emergent.tradeagentapp.kht259 and host.exp.Exponent, and app.json has usesAppleSignIn:true; (4) .gitignore negation defence holds even when *.env is appended to root .gitignore. Two pre-existing parallel-flaky tests (test_iteration.py::TestChart::test_chart_ranges[1W] and test_security_part2.py::TestFinding5OtpPumpingIsCapped::test_a_different_address_is_unaffected) both pass when re-run in isolation — same class as the two flakies main agent flagged. REVIEW_OTP is confirmed not committed anywhere except backend/.env (which the negation intentionally keeps in the tree for the deploy image).
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — no bugs were reproduced. The two parallel-flakies observed under `pytest -n 2` both PASS when re-run standalone; they are network/rate-limit or shared-state contention artifacts of the loadscope-parallel runner and are the same class of flakiness the main agent already documented for test_wallet_sanity_iter12 and test_wallet_razorpay_admin.
